subject: The Veritas Search finale: Weighing of Handsome Dan
text:
THE VERITAS SEARCH III: FINALE

The capsule hunt ends Tuesday 11/17 at 10:00pm. But first:

CEREMONIAL WEIGHING OF HANDSOME DAN
Tuesday, November 17, 8:30pm, Beinecke Plaza
Guess his weight. The closest guess wins a capsule. The entry form closes at 8:10pm and you must be present to win.

Yale College Council
